name: SpecStream
listing_line: A research agent on your own server
short_description: Ask a question and get a written report from the live web, with the page behind each cited sentence. Reports stay on your server.
price: The app is free. A report costs $0.10 (quick), $0.30 (standard) or $1.00 (deep) on your SpecStream account. A new account starts with $10 of credit.

variables.name: web_pass
variables.label: Password of the research page
variables.description: Vultr makes this password for each server. Sign in to the page with the user name research and this password.

variables.name: specstream_api_key
variables.label: SpecStream API key (optional)
variables.description: Your API key from https://specstream.ai/workspace. Leave it empty to save the key on the page after the server starts.

copy_status: The readme and the instructions wait for the writer agent before the profile is submitted.
